units.text: The Technology Code of Practice (TCoP) is a cross-government agreed standard used for the Cabinet Office spend control process and the Local Digital Declaration.
units.text_start: used for the Cabinet Office spend control process

units.text: You must consider all points of the TCoP as part of the Cabinet Office spend control process. If your project or programme needs spend control approval you should contact the GDS Assurance team at digital-spend-assurance@dsit.gov.uk for guidance with the approvals process.
units.text_start: You must consider all points of the TCoP

units.text: Where legacy technology limits your ability to adhere to the TCoP, you must explain this to the GDS Assurance team.
units.text_start: Where legacy technology limits your ability to adhere to the TCoP
units.text_end: you must explain this to the GDS Assurance team

units.text: Understand your users and their needs. Develop knowledge of your users and what that means for your technology project or programme.
units.text_start: Understand your users and their needs
units.text_end: what that means for your technology project or programme

units.text: Consider using public cloud solutions first as stated in the Cloud First policy.
units.text_start: Consider using public cloud solutions first
units.text_end: as stated in the Cloud First policy

units.text: Keep systems and data safe with the appropriate level of security.
units.text_end: with the appropriate level of security

units.text: Make sure users rights are protected by integrating privacy as an essential part of your system.
units.text_start: integrating privacy as an essential part of your system

units.text: Avoid duplicating effort and unnecessary costs by collaborating across government and sharing and reusing technology, data, and services.
units.text_start: collaborating across government and sharing and reusing

units.text: Your purchasing strategy must show you’ve considered commercial and technology aspects, and contractual limitations.
units.text_start: Your purchasing strategy must show you’ve considered
units.text_end: commercial and technology aspects, and contractual limitations

units.text: Increase sustainability throughout the lifecycle of your technology.
If you’re building a service as part of your technology project or programme you will also need to meet the Service Standard
units.text_start: you will also need to meet the Service Standard
